mapper.sql: e.id, e.real_name AS realName, e.department_id AS departmentId, d.dept_name AS departmentName, e.regist_level_id AS registLevelId, r.regist_name AS registLevelName, e.active
FROM employee e JOIN department d ON d.id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN regist_level r ON r.id = e.regist_level_id

where.if: AND (e.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.dept_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee (real_name, department_id, regist_level_id, scheduling_id, active) VALUES (#{realName}, #{departmentId}, #{registLevelId}, #{schedulingId}, #{active})
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET real_name = #{draft.realName}, department_id = #{draft.departmentId}, regist_level_id = #{draft.registLevelId}, scheduling_id = #{draft.schedulingId}, active = #{draft.active} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE employee SET active = #{active} WHERE id = #{id}
